node.title: Re: How install multiple version of perl
node.author: swl
node.doctext:
See [https://perlbrew.pl/|perlbrew] or, if on Windows, [https://github.com/dnmfarrell/berrybrew|berrybrew]. Their respective manuals instruct how to switch between versions.

Edit - although berrybrew can only provide versions for which [http://strawberryperl.com/releases.html|Strawberry Perl] was released.
